introducing_action: Commit f1f3f97 performed a portfolio consolidation (10 territories → 5 invention slots) and rewrote CANONICAL_STATE/PORTFOLIO.json from scratch. In doing so it: (1) updated frozen_at_version for CV-T06 to V22.6 and CV-T07 to V5 to reflect the real frozen versions that had been advanced through earlier territory work; (2) DROPPED the supersession_index field that had been present in the pre-consolidation PORTFOLIO.json; (3) did NOT append corresponding version-advance transitions to epistemic_integrity/approved_provenance/state_transition_ledger.ndjson. The ledger's terminal entries for CV-T06 and CV-T07 therefore remain at the bootstrap versions (V6 and V4 respectively) recorded at commit dcd8d452 on 2026-08-18 with reason 'BOOTSTRAPPED_FROM_CANONICAL_STATE'.

root_cause: Asymmetric state mutation during portfolio consolidation: PORTFOLIO.json was rewritten from scratch at f1f3f97, treating it as the canonical state authority, while (a) the append-only state transition ledger was not updated to reflect the version advances that had accumulated through prior territory work (V6→V22.6 for T06 across the R6 benchtop hardening cycle; V4→V5 for T07 at its negative-ceiling freeze), and (b) the supersession_index field was dropped from the new PORTFOLIO.json. The bootstrap transitions recorded at dcd8d452 (2026-08-18, reason=BOOTSTRAPPED_FROM_CANONICAL_STATE) anchored the ledger at the bootstrap versions and were never superseded by EVIDENCE_BACKED transitions for the version advances. This violates the principle that the ledger is the source of truth for state transitions — PORTFOLIO.json is supposed to be a deterministic projection of the ledger, not an independent authority that can drift ahead of it or lose fields during rewrites.

why_round20_did_not_introduce_it.ancestry_check: f1f3f97 (the introducing commit) is an ancestor of ce4de1f (the Round-19 baseline), which is an ancestor of 55fb72b (Round 20). Therefore both failures (G5 drift + E1 missing index) existed at the Round-19 baseline and were carried forward unchanged through Round 20.
why_round20_did_not_introduce_it.conclusion: Round 20 introduced zero changes to PORTFOLIO.json, the state transition ledger, or the preflight checker. Both the G5 version drift and the E1 missing supersession_index are wholly attributable to f1f3f97 (2026-08-19) and were present at the verified ce4de1f baseline. Round 20 inherits the issues but did not cause them.

expiry_policy.description: A quarantined failure must NOT become a permanent exception. If remediation_deadline passes without remediation_state transitioning to REMEDIATED, the quarantine EXPIRES and the failure returns to RED — forcing either remediation or explicit CEO escalation.
expiry_policy.on_expiry: If remediation_deadline passes and remediation_state != REMEDIATED, the registry's find_match() returns None for this record, causing G5 to fail RED with 'QUARANTINE_EXPIRED'. This forces the issue back to attention rather than letting it silently persist.
expiry_policy.review_trigger: At each review_after timestamp, the gate must log a revalidation entry. If no revalidation has occurred within review_interval_days * 2, the quarantine is treated as STALE and fails RED.
